notes: Corsica Sardinia Ferries (Corsica Ferries) operates from Livorno Maritime Station to two destinations: Bastia (Corsica, France) and Golfo Aranci (Sardinia, IT). Confirmed by corsica-ferries.co.uk, netferry.com and portolivorno2000.it. Routes, ordered stops (Livorno origin -> single destination port) and crossing durations are well-evidenced. However the sources do NOT publish an exact fixed departure/arrival timetable (times vary by date/season); aggregators give ranges only: Bastia earliest 08:00 / latest 18:30, ~6h with Corsica Ferries, ~22 weekly sailings; Golfo Aranci 2 departures/day May-Sep (a day crossing ~7h and a night crossing ~9.5h), 1/day off-season, first ~07:30. Representative trips use realistic clock times within these evidenced windows rather than a scraped exact schedule, hence moderate confidence (~0.45). Stop coordinates: Livorno Stazione Marittima (Calata Carrara / Piazzale dei Marmi 12) 43.55539,10.30159 from portolivorno2000; Golfo Aranci Nuova Stazione Marittima 40.99471,9.62157 (official Corsica Ferries figure); Bastia port 42.6973,9.4509. route_type=4 (ferry). Night Golfo Aranci arrival crosses midnight -> GTFS >24h notation (32:15:00). calendar covers the year (daily); note real off-season frequency drops but daily service assumed for the representative feed.
